content:
Pioneer is a CarPlay head unit brand favoured by many car owners, and it has now entered the iPhone accessories market for the first time. The company has launched a series of iPhone accessories for car use, including MagSafe wireless chargers and phone mounts.

Pioneer's iPhone accessories line-up includes:

  • Three brand-new MagSafe air vent phone mounts: a mount-only model, a model with MagSafe charging support, and a model that supports both MagSafe charging and has a built-in cooling fan.
  • A dual-slot car charger: a traditional dual-slot car charger equipped with USB-C and USB-A ports.
  • USB-C cables: available in silicone and braided versions, supporting wired CarPlay.

Pioneer has produced many excellent products over the years, so seeing it expand into the traditional iPhone accessories market is quite exciting. My personal top pick for an in-car USB-C charger is the model with a retractable cable. The one I have been using seems to have been discontinued, but this one from UGREEN is a good alternative.

You can purchase Pioneer's full new range of iPhone accessories on Amazon. What are your favourite in-car iPhone accessories? Feel free to share them in the comments section.
